__README__: The hand-kept half of the Estate tool (/estate/). Everything the repo can describe for itself – pages, cloud jobs, GitHub jobs – is scanned by scripts/build-inventory.js. This file adds what the repo cannot know: a plain name and 'what it does' where the scan has none, how long a thing is meant to live, its status, a note, and the things that live outside this repo (Apps Script projects not in gas/, Claude skills). Keys: tool:<toolKey>, page:<folder or file>, fn:<function>, gh:<workflow file>, gas:<project>, skill:<name>. lifespan: Ongoing | One-off. status: Core | Occasional | Dead | Not decided (blank = Not decided). Only Richard sets status and lifespan; notes record decisions with their date. PUBLIC REPO: no names, emails or data.
